sentences.text: Counter affidavit filed today by learned A.G.A. is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3. The applicant is the mother in law, allegation with regard to dowry death was leveled against the entire family members.
It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the father in law has been enlarged on bail vide order 22.12.2023, keeping into consideration that the father in law was having a separate living.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the allegations against the applicant and the father in law are similar and the applicant being the mother in law is residing with her husband in a separate living, on the ground of parity, the applicant is also enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Savitri Singh be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 251 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Lambhua, District Sultanpur, on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
